explanation: The test covers the rollback behavior on timeout, which relates indirectly to the credit_before_debit requirement by ensuring no debit or credit occurs on timeout. However, it does not explicitly verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock) or that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual_approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000. The test misses asserting that the FX rate remains constant during the transaction and does not verify the order of credit and debit operations in a successful transaction. A concrete missed assertion is verifying that the FX rate is locked at the moment of top-up initiation. A concrete bug this test would miss is if the system debited the funding source before crediting the wallet, violating the transactional order requirement.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify second owner approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: If the system debits the funding source before crediting the destination wallet, this test would not detect it because it only checks for rollback on timeout, not the order of operations in a successful transaction.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify FX rate lock, credit-before-debit order, rollback on timeout, and dual approval for large top-ups
steps: Initiate a top-up of SGD 5000 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate remains constant during transaction
Complete top-up successfully and verify destination wallet credited before funding source debited
Initiate a top-up and simulate payment provider timeout after 5 seconds
Verify wallet balance and funding source remain unchanged after timeout
Attempt to settle without second owner approval and verify settlement is blocked
Obtain second owner approval and verify settlement completes successfully
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate locked at initiation; destination wallet credited before funding source debited; on timeout, no debit or credit occurs; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second owner approval before settlement
